components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Compact Pegas-blue action for the single primary decision in a region.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 10px); color: #fff; background: var(--blue, #4d6bfe); font: 620 0.8125rem/1.38 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #4d6bfe) 46%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-action-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); }

components.name: Circular Send Action
components.description: Circular icon action for committing a composed message.
components.html: <button class="ds-send" aria-label="Send"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 12 7-7 7 7M12 19V5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; background: var(--blue, #4d6bfe); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-send svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; } .ds-send:hover { background: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #4d6bfe) 46%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-send:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Selected Navigation Item
components.description: Neutral selected row that keeps blue reserved for Pegas identity and counts.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; color: rgba(20,20,20,.62); background: transparent; font: 520 0.86rem/1.3 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item.ds-is-selected { color: var(--ink, #141414); background: rgba(20,20,20,.09); } .ds-nav-item.ds-is-selected { font-weight: 620; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #4d6bfe) 46%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(.985); } .ds-nav-count { display: grid; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; color: #fff; background: var(--blue, #4d6bfe); font-size: .65rem; }

components.name: Pegas Message
components.description: Actor-led response surface with the Pegas identity immediately visible.
components.html:
P
I have organized the request into a durable task and started the first step.
components.css: .ds-message-row { display: grid; max-width: 760px; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: end; gap: 9px; color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 400 .9rem/1.68 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-message-avatar { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; place-items: center; border-radius: 9px; color: #fff; background: var(--blue, #4d6bfe); font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 760; } .ds-message-pegas { padding: 13px 16px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--bubble, #eeeeee); }

components.name: User Message
components.description: High-contrast authored message aligned to the user's side of the dialogue.
components.html: <article class="ds-message-user">Turn this request into an executable plan and keep the risks visible.</article>
components.css: .ds-message-user { max-width: 760px; padding: 13px 18px; border-radius: 16px; color: #fff; background: #070707; font: 400 .9rem/1.65 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Conversation Composer
components.description: Bottom writing capsule with restrained utility actions and one clear send control.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: grid; width: min(100%, 992px); min-height: 56px; padding: 11px 12px 9px 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.15); border-radius: 22px; color: var(--ink, #141414); background: var(--paper, #fff); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(20,20,20,.08); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #4d6bfe) 48%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(20,20,20,.10); } .ds-composer label { font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 620; } .ds-composer textarea { min-height: 32px; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-composer-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 9px; } .ds-composer-utility, .ds-composer-send { width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer-utility { color: rgba(20,20,20,.62); background: rgba(20,20,20,.055); } .ds-composer-send { color: #fff; background: var(--blue, #4d6bfe); } .ds-composer-utility:hover { color: var(--ink, #141414); background: rgba(20,20,20,.09); } .ds-composer-send:hover { background: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #4d6bfe) 46%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Quiet settings field with a structural boundary and explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 620 .8125rem/1.38 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.15); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink, #141414); background: var(--paper, #fff); font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: rgba(20,20,20,.28); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #4d6bfe) 48%, transparent); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #4d6bfe) 46%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Grouped Settings Rows
components.description: Inspectible related settings with internal dividers and almost no elevation.
components.css: .ds-settings-group { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.15); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--paper, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,20,.04); } .ds-settings-row { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.08); color: var(--ink, #141414); background: transparent; font: 620 .8125rem/1.38 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-settings-row small { color: #666; font-weight: 400; } .ds-settings-row:hover { background: rgba(20,20,20,.05); } .ds-settings-row.ds-is-selected { background: var(--blue-soft, #eef1ff); } .ds-settings-row:focus-visible { position: relative; outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #4d6bfe) 46%, transparent); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Floating Page Pill
components.description: Compact floating context and workspace control at the top of the main column.
components.css: .ds-page-pill { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 4px 7px 4px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.15); border-radius: 18px; color: var(--ink, #141414); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--canvas, #fcfcfc) 82%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(20,20,20,.08); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); font: 400 .69rem/1.3 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-page-pill strong { font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 670; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-page-pill span { color: #666; } .ds-page-pill button { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; color: rgba(20,20,20,.62); background: transparent; font: 570 .71rem/1.3 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-page-pill button:hover { color: var(--ink, #141414); background: rgba(20,20,20,.07); } .ds-page-pill button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue, #4d6bfe) 46%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Pegas should feel like a reliable execution partner keeping a calm, legible record beside the user. Natural dialogue is the foreground; durable tasks, progress, and controls remain close enough to inspect without turning the product into a cockpit. The visual system therefore favors quiet neutral fields, compact controls, and obvious state changes over decoration.

The shell is restrained and workmanlike: near-white canvas, pale navigation, soft gray conversation surfaces, strong black ink, and one clear Pegas blue. Identity appears through the P or robot mark and through disciplined blue moments—not through ornamental branding. Density is comfortable rather than sparse, and every floating element must earn its elevation through function.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral, actor-led workspace with dialogue at the center.
Pegas blue reserved for identity, selection, progress, and primary action.
Durable task state embedded in the conversation and available in deeper work views.
Flat, inspectable surfaces with ambient elevation only for floating controls and overlays.
Desktop structure that collapses cleanly into touch-safe mobile navigation and full-screen settings.

rules.name: The One Blue Voice Rule
rules.body: Pegas blue is reserved for identity, selection, progress, focus, and the primary action; it must not become ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Neutral Field Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy by moving between canvas, paper, sidebar, and conversation neutrals before adding color.

rules.name: The Conversation First Rule
rules.body: Body text must remain more readable than surrounding metadata; operational chrome should never compete with the dialogue.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting content surfaces use tone and dividers; elevation belongs only to functional floating layers.

dos: Do keep dialogue and durable task state in one continuous, inspectable flow.
Do use Pegas blue sparingly for identity, selection, progress, focus, and primary actions.
Do preserve the 280px → 88px → 62px navigation transformation across desktop, compact desktop, and mobile.
Do use tonal layering and quiet dividers before reaching for shadow or color.
Do preserve clear focus indication, readable contrast, reduced-motion behavior, and 44px coarse-pointer targets.
donts: Don't introduce decorative gradients, cobalt-tinted paper fields, or ornamental effects.
Don't turn the interface into a collection of generic dashboard cards or oversized hero panels.
Don't use Pegas blue as a broad background wash or decoration unrelated to state or action.
Don't make transport, runtime, or implementation details louder than the user's conversation and tasks.
Don't replace the Pegas P or robot identity with unrelated mascots or borrowed brand motifs.
